name: Cloudflare Relay
description: Connect Orca Mobile to this desktop from anywhere through your free Cloudflare account. After installing, click "Set up relay" (cloud icon) in the status bar (or run "Set up / open panel") and follow 3 steps. Phones pair with a normal QR code; no app changes needed. Not affiliated with Cloudflare.

commands.title: Cloudflare Relay: Set up / open panel

statusBarItems.tooltip: Cloudflare Relay for Orca Mobile. Click to open.

settings.title: Connection type (set up in the Cloudflare Relay panel)
settings.description: Start here: open the Cloudflare Relay panel (click "Set up relay" in the status bar, the cloud icon in the right sidebar, or run "Cloudflare Relay: Set up / open panel" on this page). The panel walks you through it in about 2 minutes: choose a type, connect Cloudflare, scan a QR code. Changing this setting alone does not set anything up. Worker relay: free account, stable workers.dev address (recommended). Tunnel on your domain: free account plus a domain. Quick tunnel: no account, but the address changes on every restart. Your own address: you run the tunnel or proxy yourself and the plugin only pairs phones with it.
enumLabels: Your own address (advanced: you run the tunnel/proxy)

settings.title: Start with Orca
settings.description: Reconnect automatically when Orca starts, if Cloudflare Relay was on when Orca quit.

settings.title: Also offer Orca Relay
settings.description: Put Orca Relay into the pairing QR code too, as a fallback when Cloudflare is unreachable. Needs this Orca signed in to Orca.

settings.title: Relay Worker updates
settings.description: How the relay Worker in your Cloudflare account is updated when this plugin ships a newer one. By default the panel asks and nothing is deployed until you click Update relay; a required (security) update keeps the relay off until then. Redeploying keeps your phones paired. Automatic updates are opt-in and need the Cloudflare token kept on this computer ("Keep the Cloudflare API token").
enumLabels: Install required updates automatically, ask for others

settings.title: Keep the Cloudflare API token on this computer
settings.description: Off (recommended): after the relay Worker is deployed the token is deleted from this computer, since it can edit every Worker in your account. You paste a token again only to redeploy or remove the relay. The tunnel on your domain always keeps its token to follow Orca's port.

settings.title: Advanced: Public hostname (tunnel on your domain)
settings.description: Only for "Tunnel on your domain"; set it in the panel. An unused hostname in a domain on your Cloudflare account, for example orca.example.com.

settings.title: Advanced: Tunnel name
settings.description: Only for "Tunnel on your domain": name of the Cloudflare Tunnel created in your account.

settings.title: Advanced: Relay Worker name
settings.description: Only for "Worker relay": the Worker name in your account. The relay address becomes https://<name>.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev. Change it before the first deploy.

settings.title: Advanced: Local Orca port
settings.description: Leave 0 to detect the port of Orca's mobile server automatically (usually 6768).

settings.title: Advanced: cloudflared path
settings.description: Optional. Leave empty to download a checksum-verified cloudflared automatically.

settings.title: Advanced: Orca CLI path
settings.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the CLI bundled with Orca.
